title: A Continuous-Variable Quantum Fourier Layer: Applications to Filtering and PDE Solving
summary: Fourier representations play a central role in operator learning methods for partial differential equations and are increasingly being explored in quantum machine learning architectures. The classical fast Fourier transform (FFT), particularly in its Cooley--Tukey decomposition, exhibits a structure that naturally matches continuous-variable quantum circuits. This correspondence establishes a direct structural isomorphism between the Cooley-Tukey butterfly network and Gaussian photonic gates, enabling the FFT to be realized as a native optical computation in continuous-variable quantum…
